sources.name: price_list_2026.txt
sources.content: Official Price List — Effective 1 January 2026. The ProFlow 400 conveyor unit is priced at €3,200 per unit. This list supersedes all previously issued price sheets. Approved by the Head of Sales on 15 December 2025.

sources.name: pricing_approval_q1_2026.txt
sources.content: Pricing Approval Memo — Q1 2026. Following the annual cost review, management has approved a list price of €3,200 for the ProFlow 400 conveyor unit, effective 1 January 2026. All customer quotes must be based on this rate.
